articles.title: Trade War Escalates: U.S. Bans Canadian Dairy, Booze, and Motorcycles
articles.summary: The U.S. is banning Canadian dairy, alcohol, and motorcycles in a trade war. Canada retaliated with tariffs on $20B of U.S. goods. Leaders are digging in.

articles.title: Reform UK Under Criminal Investigation Over Foreign Donation Allegations
articles.summary: Police launched a criminal probe into Reform UK after a secret recording suggested aides plotted to accept a £500,000 foreign donation. Two top figures resigned.

articles.title: Sununu vs. Pappas: High-Stakes Senate Race in New Hampshire
articles.summary: John Sununu and Chris Pappas will battle for an open Senate seat in New Hampshire, a race that could determine Senate control. Both won their primaries.
